tools.name: get_tracked_link_request
tools.description: Fetch an instant-link request, affiliate RefId, review status, and issued links using its access secret.

tools.name: request_merchant_onboarding
tools.description: Start a Clickwise merchant (advertiser) onboarding application. Describe the store; an automated evaluator replies with a follow-up question, an approval or a decline. Returns the status and an access secret to continue.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: Use this to browse the whole live catalogue page by page, filtered by merchant, category or country, when find_affiliate_programs' ranked top matches are not enough. No key needed; it shows programs anyone can join. For the programs your API key is approved in use list_my_programs.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update a creator's instant-monetization profile (claim email, display name, website, country, payment method) using the application_id + access_secret returned by request_tracked_links. Overwrites the fields provided. Lets a creator's assistant complete claim/payout details without leaving chat.

tools.description: Your individual conversions (default: last 90 days) with status, commission, currency and subid, plus a per-subid rollup. Requires your own Clickwise affiliate API key on the MCP connection (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer); acts only on your account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_feed, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request · Private data: search_products, get_product_feed, get_deal, get_news, find_affiliate_programs, request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, request_merchant_onboarding, list_programs, list_my_programs, create_tracking_links, get_performance_report, list_conversions, apply_to_program · Public sink: request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, update_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_feed, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request · Private data: search_products, get_product_feed, get_deal, get_news, find_affiliate_programs, request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, get_tracked_link_request, request_merchant_onboarding, list_programs, list_my_programs, create_tracking_links, get_performance_report, list_conversions, apply_to_program · Public sink: request_tracked_links, get_monetization_feed, update_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
